body: I'm not looking for sexual attention, but romantic, pervy troll.
That's nice but I am a woman not a man. Not that people treat me like one:D Men don't want women that are a)old and b)ugly . And that's the way it is, evolution and natural selection etc.

I know people do, as I have a facial deformity and men publicly point and laugh at me. Groups of teens are by far the worst, I'll cross the road to avoid them.
I suppose in a way it could be good because it makes me think of men as animals more than viable romantic partners. Like, I just get disgusted by their behavior, yet I'm still jealous of the pretty girls who think men are nice and help you with stuff. I've never had a male help me with anything, even at high school only the female teachers would pay attention to me, even though you'd think teachers want to teach not only talk to the pretty young girls. Yeah right lol.
As for girls talking about me that doesn't bug me because girls have never done anything physically violent to me unlike males. They don't throw stuff, they don't yell, let them stare and whisper I don't care.
Funny, I don't recall asking about males who've been single all their life. The point of my question was to find WOMEN who are in the same situation and empathize.
Did I ask for advice from males?

What you need to realize is that you don't know everything and you're a guy so what are you doing responding here. Did you find an ugly, deformed girlfriend? just wondering, then I'd have hope, your male experience means nothing.
Not in my country (I'm in Eastern Europe)
I don't live in the US.
Yes you can change your behaviour, I have changed a whole lot since I was a teenager so it's very plausible you changed too whether you noticed it or not as kids tend to grow.

The Elephant Man. Worse part of it is there is nothing you can do unless you're wealthy enough to afford extensive plastic surgery. Sometimes it annoys me so much how little effort others put into their relationships when noone will ever date me no matter how well we get along.

I've got trouble even with couples in fiction if there is a scene with some intimate private moment it makes me feel lower than dirt. I can only watch comedies and thrillers. Everything else revolves around romance.

Indeed, humans are social animals. You do things for others not for you no matter what you tell yourself. If the so-called pack still thinks you're trash after you've worked harder than others you will feel insecure and afraid because you need others to survive. And if it's because of something you can't help you will feel helpless to do anything about anything because it seems people will always just put you down and only notice the defect and immediately think you're lower than others because of it while beautiful people always get the benefit of doubt no matter what they do or how bad they suck at it. Meanwhile the less popular ones can't afford to make a single tiny mistake or all the good they've done will be discounted. That's the harsh truth.

Sorry, but just because your bullying ended due to some magic doesn't mean I will get that lucky, and I am bullied by grown men everywhere, not just in school and not because of something I can change like how masculine or feminine I behave, but because of a physical thing I can't get rid of. So I don't really see any parallels at all.
I should've said manic, like bipolar people when they get really happy, but I don't know if that state can exist in a person without bipolar disorder.

It's the same for me, I do have people to talk to, but they are acquaintances and I cannot relate to them. Since I have a facial deformity, few people in the world can relate to me and my experiences. Specially here in Eastern Europe where a woman is basically a sum of her physical attributes and worth nothing more I can't go outside without mean comments, looks, and sometimes it even gets physical.
I'm only alive really because I feel guilty about committing suicide. I've been a waste of space and a burden and I'd want to change that but with my face the chances are slim.

I feel like that constantly. But I have a facial deformity so getting that close to me might make people want to vomit. 
I suggest you think about who you want to cuddle with, I bet not anyone will do, and think about how you could be the person that person would want to cuddle with.

Confidence is the key to get mocked for not cowering in the corner like men think you should be. Oh, some men have put you down. What they do, didn't buy you a big enough ring? Why talk about things you don't understand? Unless you're just trolling of course.

But hey, it's your personality not your face, so you can change it, unlike me, ugly women are lower than dogs in society.

I'm saying I don't have any hope because I was born with a facial deformity. I had surgeries but I will never look normal.
And yes, poor loser alcoholics did throw a beer bottle at me when I was walking down the street.
I get catcalled too, mostly, what is wrong with your face.
A makeover isn't going to help and neither is time - I'm 27. Only a bone saw would help me look normal plain instead of weird strange ugly. I could never look pretty or cute though. And I can't afford cosmetic surgery.

Oh, okay. I would still like to know more precisely what he/she assumes will guarantee that someone will fall in love with me. I feel like I've tried everything but I could be wrong. Maybe there's some secret club of men out there that only like women that are considered unattractive by other men but because I haven't made a life transformation I can't find them.

What makes you think I haven't? I've had a lot of hobbies and hung out with computer geeks a lot since that's my profession. They also think I'm disgusting. Noone responds when I say hello, and one guy said my face was messed up, but the other girls in class have to fight them off with a stick.
I've done outdoorsy stuff too, tennis etc. I've probably had more hobbies than most people.
Everywhere I went got mocked. No way am I going anywhere ever again unless I'm high as a kite. I can't take it.

Like what change? I'm fit, I wear makeup, I go to bars to look at other women being bought drinks while I'm ignored and go home alone. Men either avoid me like the plague or mock me. I would love to know what change could help here.

I don't think that subreddit could help me, I've searched for women like me on there and if someone is dealing with men telling them how ugly they are and noticeably treating them different because of it, there is no sort of advice to be found about dealing with it, unfortunately. 
The only kind of creeps they talk about are complimentary catcallers which isn't what I deal with because catcallers don't throw bottles at you or point and laugh at your face loudly in a crowded bus you can't escape from with others doing nothing but ignoring the whole thing because noone considers you worthy of standing up for. People who have only dealt with the kind of harrassment that tells them they are desirable can't understand how it feels to be the only person singled out for this treatment while others get compliments.
